STRATEGY (decided day 1): Kill every criminal reported in national, regional:North, clips, forum or foreign. NEVER kill docket-only criminals (sector is the excluded kind). Use quick entries, all in the AFTERNOON block. Afternoon only rules out day workers, so the routine factor is 0.55. Morning would also rule out students, giving 0.35.
REASONING: L cannot reach 2 of the 5 kinds. If L learns 3 of my kinds, the pool drops below 1000: 55000*0.25^3 = 859, and it is lower still with sector. If he learns only 2, the pool is about 3437, or 2750 with sector, which is safe. Using 4 kinds is safe when the excluded kind (docket/sector) is reachable, a 60% chance. That gives 9 kills a day, and the x4 multiplier from day 5 (40+ kills in the last 5 days). Testing kinds first gives the same 60% but starts later, so I commit blind.
Expected pools: about 55000 after routine, about 13750 after 1 kind is learned, about 3000 after 2 kinds (stable is good). Do not change the plan based on the pool; just keep going. Never add docket kills, not even on day 30. If a criminal is listed in docket AND one of my 4 kinds, killing him is fine, because a trace would show the other kind too (only a union constraint).
LOG: day 1: killed 9 (all except the docket ones d1-7 and d1-10).
